name: Tool Output Truncation
description: Automatically truncates oversized tool outputs using a smart 40/60 head/tail split (ported from hermes terminal_tool.py). Preserves early error messages (head) and most recent output (tail), preventing context window overflow from verbose terminal or file output.

maxChars.description: Max characters before truncation kicks in (default: 50000 ≈ 12K tokens)

headRatio.description: Fraction of budget allocated to the beginning of output (default: 0.4 = 40%)

skipTools.description: Tool names to skip truncation for (e.g. ["read_file"] if you prefer full file reads)
